title: Very easy, fast assembly, attractive, strong and functional
text: Very easy, fast assembly, attractive, strong and functional. Very easy to assemble in just minutes and without any tools.  Seems like it took me 10 to 15 minutes tops.  I did have a little difficulty getting the top to slip on to the pegs that hold it; had to apply quite a bit of pressure (after I got it started on, I actually sat on it to push it down on).  Once assembled it is very solid and sturdy and not likely to fall apart easily.  It is attractive and the adjustable shelf is a plus.  I knocked off one star on my rating because this is made of pressed wood, rather than solid wood.  I think the pressed wood makes it heavier, as it is a bit on the heavy side. Many things these days are made of pressed wood and I would guess it keeps the cost down.  Also the plastic-like lamination over the press wood was chipped on one corner on the top where it was easily noticed.  That might have happened in shipping, as my box was rather beaten up when it arrived.  Fortunately it was packed well with protective Styrofoam.  Unfortunately the Styrofoam is is type that breaks apart really easily, so I had little pieces of it all over the floor that needed to be cleaned up.  Bottom line: strong, functional and attractive bookcase that is quick to assemble.
